lead.opener: Congratulations on the new LLC. Who's handling your books and your first tax filing?

script.text: Right now, a new business in the US is choosing its accountant.
Call too late, and the decision is already made.
NextGen Profit gets you there early.
Every day, we check state business filings, public notices and careers pages, across the US.
We flag what matters to accountants: new LLCs, first hires on payroll, bookkeeping roles that stay open.
script.say: We flag what matters to accountants: new L L Cs, first hires on payroll, bookkeeping roles that stay open.

script.text: Each lead has phone, email, website, the owner's name where public, and the event with date and source.
Plus a short sales briefing: why now, what they likely need, and how to win them.
Every lead is scored. Below sixty, we don't deliver it.
Every Monday, you get a PDF briefing and a spreadsheet. No software needed.
And each lead goes to one firm per industry. Not to your competitors.
Start with ten free leads, and judge for yourself.
NextGen Profit. The right companies, at the right moment.
